# jenkins_credential_vault_string (Data Source)

Get the attributes of a vault secret text credential within Jenkins.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the resource being read.

### Optional

- `domain` (String) The domain store containing this resource.
- `folder` (String) The folder namespace containing this resource.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A human readable description of the credentials being stored.
- `engine_version` (Number) The KV engine version of the Vault secrets engine.
- `id` (String) The full canonical job path, e.g. `/job/job-name`
- `namespace` (String) The Vault namespace to read the secret from.
- `path` (String) The Vault path of the secret to read.
- `prefix_path` (String) The Vault mount prefix path prepended to `path`.
- `scope` (String) The visibility of the credentials to Jenkins agents. This will be either "GLOBAL" or "SYSTEM".
- `vault_key` (String) The key within the Vault secret the value is read from.
